Kinetik is strategically located in the heart of the Delaware Basin in the Permian, one of the fastest growing oil and gas development regions in the world. We provide the gathering, compression, processing, transportation and water management services required to bring natural gas, natural gas liquids and crude oil to market and are dedicated to providing the best service and netback for our customers. We are driven to be best-in-class and committed to growing our existing assets in the Permian Basin through both greenfield and acquisition opportunities.

pages.raw_meta: Kinetik is the premier midstream operator in the Delaware Basin providing unique solutions with gas, crude, water and transmission services.
raw_blocks: Kinetik is the premier midstream operator in the Delaware Basin.

Through our gas, natural gas liquids, crude, water and transmission service offerings, we are able to provide a unique set of solutions for each of our customers, tailored to maximize growth and efficiency. Every day, we strive to exceed the expectations of our customers through safe and reliable operations, collaboration and transparency. We are committed partners and emphasize the importance of safety, integrity, service and teamwork. At Kinetik, we are proud to support our customers in the most exciting and robust oil and gas basin in the world, the Permian Basin.
“Kinetik’s collaborative culture prioritizes teamwork and utilizes everyone’s individual strengths to achieve the best possible outcomes.”

Texas crude oil reserves and natural gas reserves represent almost 25 percent and more than 30% of the U.S. total reserves, respectively. Texas’s largest remaining oil reserves are concentrated in the Permian Basin, where more than 20 of the nation’s top 100 oil fields are located. This prolific basin covers more than 75,000 square miles and 25 counties in West Texas and Eastern New Mexico.

pages.raw_title: Largest Midstream Operator in Delaware Basin | Kinetik
pages.raw_meta: Kinetik is the largest midstream operator in the Delaware Basin, offering gathering, compression, processing, transportation and water management services.
raw_blocks: We provide premier, mission-critical midstream solutions to the Permian’s producers.

Kinetik is one of the the largest independent gathering and processing companies in the Delaware Basin. We safely provide midstream services to our customers with the speed, flexibility, and customer first approach of a smaller organization, while our scale offers system reliability, interconnectivity, redundancy and market optionality unmatched by our peers.

With decades of experience in West Texas, we provide the critical services our customers need to deliver gas, natural gas liquids, and crude oil production to market, including gathering, transportation, compression, processing and produced water management.

“We take pride in partnering with our customers to provide innovative midstream solutions to unlock hydrocarbons safely and reliably. Safety is deeply ingrained in our core values and is the driving force behind every decision we make.”
Alex Cummins Assistant Plant Supervisor
Our system was designed and constructed to accommodate continued growth in the basin through the utilization of large-diameter, high-MAOP steel pipelines and large-scale field located compression.
Impressive Takeaway Capacity from the Permian to the Texas Coast Markets

In addition to connectivity to several third-party residue and NGL outlets, Kinetik has reserved firm capacity on the 430-mile Permian Highway Pipeline (PHP), transporting energy from the Permian Basin to growing markets along the Texas Gulf Coast.
Over 90 Producers rely on Kinetik for Midstream Services

Sufficient processing capacity and takeaway capacity are crucial to support continued development activity in the Delaware basin and are top priority for our producer customers. With approximately 1,400,000 serviced acres, Kinetik provides premier, mission-critical midstream solutions for producers operating in the Permian. Transporting oil and gas safely and responsibly to market is imperative to ensure the steady flow of energy to fuel our lives.
